items.title: Russian National Pleads Guilty to Evading Economic Sanctions on Russia
items.summary: Alexander Suvorov, 52, a Russian national formerly residing in Sweden, pleaded guilty today to conspiracy to violate the Export Control Reform Act (ECRA).

items.title: Member of Global Insider Trading Network Extradited to United States for Securities Fraud and Money Laundering Offenses
items.summary: BOSTON – A Singaporean citizen has been extradited to the United States to face federal securities fraud and money laundering charges in Boston.

items.title: NHTSA Recall 25V359000 (Tesla Model Y): VISIBILITY:WINDSHIELD WIPER/WASHER:LINKAGES
items.summary: 30/05/2025: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y vehicles. The hose connector may block the windshield washer nozzles, preventing washer fluid from reaching the windshield. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 104, "Windshield Wiping and Washing Systems."

items.title: NHTSA Recall 25V410000 (Tesla Model Y): SEATS:CRITICAL FASTENERS
items.summary: 18/06/2025: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles. The fasteners attaching the seat back to the seat bottom may have been improperly tightened.

items.title: NHTSA Recall 25V490000 (Tesla Model Y): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:HORN
items.summary: 28/07/2025: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y vehicles. The ring terminal of the horn ground wire may be improperly secured, allowing the circuit to open and preventing the horn from sounding.

items.title: Light-Walled Rectangular Pipe and Tube From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of Countervailing Duty Administrative Review; 2024
items.source: Federal Register (Commerce Department, International Trade Administration)
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that countervailable subsidies were not provided to Hangzhou Ailong Metal Products Co., Ltd. (Hangzhou Ailong), a producer and exporter of light- walled rectangular pipe and tube (LWR pipe and tube) from People's Republic of China (China). The period of review (POR) is January 1, 2024, through December 31, 2024.
